_doc: Satellite Shadow prop manifest. IDs match ASSETS.md. fit = which extent is scaled to `meters` (height = Y, width = largest of X/Z, max = largest of X/Y/Z). category 'hard' adds planar dissolve for crisp flat faces; 'organic' keeps the silhouette soft. route 'img3d' = concept image -> TripoSR -> Blender cleanup; 'proc' = thin geometry that image-to-3D cannot do well: keep procedural or hand-model, then run it through the cleanup with --mesh. Output: assets/props/<ID>_<name>_<variant>.glb
style_prompt: Stylized low-poly 3D game asset, flat-shaded faceted polygons, bold simple silhouette, muted natural colours, {desc}, single isolated object, centered, three-quarter view from the front-right, camera slightly above, plain pure white background, soft even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no text, no frame
